description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'TextHelperServiceTest' that tests various string manipulation methods (length, containment, start and end checks) of the 'TextHelperService' class within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. The test class verifies functionality with different string inputs, including Unicode characters.

classes.name: TextHelperServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for verifying the string utility methods of the TextHelperService class in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the TextHelperService instance before each test.

methods.name: testStrLength
methods.description: Tests the strLength method for strings with ASCII and Unicode characters.

methods.name: testStrContains
methods.description: Tests the strContains method to check substring presence.

methods.name: testStrStartsWith
methods.description: Tests the strStartsWith method for string prefixes.

methods.name: testStrEndsWith
methods.description: Tests the strEndsWith method for string suffixes.
